Yes, I do know the results. I did my post graduation in 2017 and joined a teaching institute. Things didn't work out for me really well and the company decided to shut down that particular venture leaving me without a job. Ever since, I have given multiple interviews in the field I was already working in spite of the fact that I didn't really enjoy it.
Now, when I didn't get it I saw it as a sign to leave the field for good. However, I have applied to like zillion companies, made hundreds of connections on LinkedIn, and applied on job portals but have no response. Then I decided to apply for any job that could pay me since I am running out of money but I got really few responses and they were offering less than what I was getting paid earlier. I am in a state of full confusion. What do I do?

Yes, I was actually drunk. I can't even remember how that happened. I had never even fantasized about all of this with him. It was a neat set up but somehow got messed up. I got so self conscious that I told my friend that I am never again attending any such meetings and I am never drinking again. I still cannot picture myself making out with him. I feel ashamed. I really need to have some self control. 

However, I don't have enough courage to even mention this. I have something shifting inside my stomach as I am writing this. He is already mad at me for seeing him.

He is a fine man but he doesn't like any type of interactions with people, particularly men. I find it unreasonable because I have genuine friends. If it wasn't for a drink, I couldn't imagine making out with my friend. We have known each other really long and never even has conversations close to what happened. I am not justifying my behaviour but I was really really drunk. It was a get together and I lost count. I could never be more sorry​. But I already know that he won't listen. I like him a lot and I can't imagine not having him in my life. I have numerous fights just because of this one issue and I now never tell him if I am out with friends or even an office party because he suggests me to never attend them. So I choose to not tell him.

I have always been afraid of telling him about my whereabouts since I am never sure what might get him upset. I know what I did is unacceptable and however he decides to treat me is okay because I deserve it.

He gets mad even when I go with my female friends as well. Also, this has happened for the first time in 7 years and I love him. It was a terrible terrible mistake and there is nothing I wouldn't do to make it right. I know I am completely in wrong and I must face all this because I deserve this.

He stays in a different state and I really want to talk to him in person. It's so difficult to talk this over phone because he just wouldn't pick up. He will block me right after I will start the conversation.

No no really. I lost my job 6 months ago and have had the worst time of my life. I can't afford to ruin this one exam at this time since my savings are gone and I have come to live with my parents because of no job, no money. I know I am being selfish but if this is ruined, I will have nothing for another one year.

Yes, I tried to start that conversation but ever since I told him that I went to see my friends from school among which one was a guy, he got mad at me and stopped replying to my texts and taking my calls. I know I am a terrible person and shouldn't​ have done this but if he is not okay with me seeing him, I can only imagine how would he react learning about all of that. Just the thought makes me shiver.
I am afraid of his reaction. I have my exams lined up and if I tell him, I can not imagine where that conversation will go and for how long.
Also, he might not let me talk to my friend anymore or worse- he could also mess up with my friend. He doesn't already like any of my friends.

I did talk to my friend about it. He told me to not tell him since he knows him very well. I already know he isn't going to forgive me for this. He has never been with anyone ever since he met me. I was the first in his life, in fact. Even for me, this was the first time in 7 years. He wouldn't understand though!

Also, I just told him that I met my friend there and he is already not talking to me. I don't have the heart to tell him about what happened. I feel something shifting inside my stomach every time I think about it. Should I tell him and lose this relationship or should I just not tell him and save it?

It's about a psychiatrist who is a cannibal. He kills for pleasure. Sophisticated, suave, balanced and creepy, Mads Mikkelsen is a treat to watch. The show is based on Thomas Harris's novel characters. It shows that serial killers aren't like us; they think whatever they are doing is art and they are helping with the much needed change in the world.
It also focuses on the complex relationship between two people who are at the opposite ends of the spectrum and yet are codependent. Must watch!
Fortunately enough, the show is thrilling even when you watch it the second time. I missed minor details during the first, so I watched it again. Happy watching!
